title: Camera follow without roundPixels
intent: Make the camera follow the player smoothly and settle exactly centred on it

attempts.failureReason: Phaser Camera.preRender floors scrollX and scrollY after lerping, so once the camera is within 10 px each 0.1 lerp step is under 1 px and gets floored away, parking it up to 9 px off-centre

evidence.description: camera offset was 9.0 px on both axes with roundPixels on and 0.0 px after the fix
the fix landed in this commit

constraints.statement: Keep roundPixels false in camera.startFollow while the follow lerp is below 1

result.summary: Camera centres to 0.0 px offset and clamps at the arena corners
